counting_policy: These deliberately qualified experimental public interfaces are additional to, not members of, the 177 explicit exports. Do not classify every unexported name as internal.

apis.public_signature: scientific_metadata(result) for the explicitly defined supported result types; no universal fallback
apis.inputs: PropertyResult, TrajectoryResult, ObservableSeries, ScientificDataset, LagrangianAnalysis, HamiltonianAnalysis, MechanicsDynamics, MechanicalLinearization, NormalModeAnalysis, ScientificModel, ScientificLearningResult, GeneralizationAnalysis, AtomisticSnapshot, AtomisticSystemAnalysis, AtomisticTrajectoryView, PINNPoints, PINNProblem, PINNTrainingResult, PINNAnalysis
apis.returns: NamedTuple of scoped claims, method, backend, approximation, units, domain, coordinates, tolerances, reference, execution, sampling, rng, options, ownership, provenance; availability slots distinguish known/unknown/not_applicable
apis.errors: Unsupported type has no defined public method; metadata inspection does not validate arbitrary fabricated raw records
apis.optional_dependencies: No additional import needed for the base methods; constructing backend-dependent payloads retains those families' extension requirements
apis.numerical_limitations: No recomputation, overall confidence score, accuracy bound or certification; known means present, not proven
apis.units: Existing units are described, not inferred or converted; string labels remain caller declarations
apis.ownership: Metadata values are borrowed/read-only; provenance is detached; native source/result may still retain arrays and backend objects
apis.docstring_status: Present and explicit; supported-type table and slot-by-slot tutorial still needed

apis.public_signature: scientific_origin(result) for supported concrete result types; no universal fallback
apis.inputs: Explicit supported result types listed alongside scientific_metadata; PropertyResult is a special unknown-origin case
apis.returns: Detached bounded NamedTuple descriptor with type, process-local token, operation, parents, truncation and identity_scope; PropertyResult returns (availability=:unknown,value=nothing)
apis.errors: Unsupported types have no public method; missing recorded ancestry is not reconstructed
apis.optional_dependencies: None beyond constructing the relevant result
apis.numerical_limitations: Tokens are object identity within the originating process, not persistent reproducibility hashes or scientific equality; ancestry is bounded and can be truncated
apis.ownership: Descriptor contains no source objects, closures or datasets; only whitelisted bounded parent descriptors
apis.docstring_status: Present, explicit warning; future reference needs supported types and truncation illustration
